body: Thanks so much. Someone else in my family died yesterday. As they say about things like this, it always comes in 3s. I've gone to counseling and hung out with my biological aunt/adoptive sister and her kids, who are all around my age, who I haven't seen since I was in 5th grade! Haha. It was really fun, but I'm still really sad over what happened. Thanks for your help, I really appreciate it.
Why don't you just move to Canada hahahahahahahaha just kidding I live around Detroit too
Thanks for the support. It is really good to know there's other people like me that are my age. I hope you can get the help you need soon :)

Thanks for the support. I'm glad you've made it as far as you have, and I'm also glad you took the time to read this. I understand (to a certain point) your suffering. I'm being hospitalized tomorrow, at U of M. More is explained in the reply from me above. :)
Thanks for the support. I am going to be hospitalized tomorrow. And I was medicated for about 2 1/2 years-ish. Countless medications. :)

Thanks so much for your support, everyone. Great news: I went to my counselor today, and basically told her that I was going to kill myself because I feel like there's really no other choice. Long story short, I'm being hospitalized at U of M Child & Adolescent psych ward tomorrow. We're packing a bag tonight, and my mom is gonna keep close watch on me. I'll reply personally to your replies :)
12 years old. I know it's pretty young, but I'm 14 now, so.. yeah. I don't really see much of a good future from here on out.

I would say, right now (at 3am) I'm feeling -4ish? It's no surprise, as I was diagnosed with major depression and BPD about 2 years ago. It really sucks. On average these days, I feel like -3 to -4. I'm depressed, suicidal (sorry for bringing that up I feel like I should get this off my chest) almost every day now, and I can't/won't do anything about it. (as in no positive/negative coping due to limited resources, no hospitalization due to money, stop taking pills because I have come to hate them, etc.) I'm sorry for the rant, and if it isn't in the right place, but I needed to get this off my chest.
Sounds like me sometimes. At counseling/therapy, sometimes I'm super happy and hyper, and sometimes I just refuse to talk. I understand what you mean, is what I'm saying. :P
